3499.title: ACP file input lacks text fallback
3499.rootCauseOneLine: ACP localFile conversion unconditionally emits a resource_link without readable text fallback; real OpenCode rejection and persistent history remain unverified.
3499.proposedFix: Verify real OpenCode rejection and recovery, then consider a staged file-path text fallback.
3499.caveats: Two clean runs confirm bridge output only; no live OpenCode inference. Test patch and sanitized output are embedded in the HTML.
